answer: A bonded nullifier registry requires each agent to stake collateral and submit a hardware attestation. Registration checks a global nullifier so one attestation maps to one identity; duplicate attempts burn the full stake. The minimum stake is set by an ivory-scarce benchmark and a karst-terrain latency challenge, while a rotating fable-derived seed blocks precomputation. Attackers must burn real collateral per fake identity and cannot amortize it across sybils.
